description: This Java class 'MessagingHook' is part of the testing framework for the Fineract project. It uses Cucumber annotations to define a hook that resets the EventStore before each scenario.

classes.name: MessagingHook
classes.description: A test hook class that resets the EventStore before each Cucumber scenario in the testing framework.
